title: Education Swap 👨‍🎓
tagline: Education Swap is a platform for students to swap their tokens for stable coins. The way it works is that students can create a project to track their educational goals and receive financial support.
description:
Education Swap is a platform for students to swap their tokens for stable coins. The way it works is that students can create a project to track their educational goals and receive financial support.

With the IPFS chain, all projects and products created by users will be securely stored on the blockchain and can be referenced as the owner’s Intellectual Property.
how_its_made:
Education Swap application makes use of the following softwares:



- `NFTStorage`for data storage on IPFS that generates a transation hash used to create an NFT of a project.



Uniswap V3 for the smart contract.



Skynet facilitated the process of deploying our dApp front-end application in a seamless way.



HardHat for local blockchain development.



Kovalent Network is the network that we deployed our dApp.



React Js, Material-UI, Web3 React Js for the frontend, Material-ui and Web3 to connect to the blockchain.
